notes: Serial CNOT/H/M/M = 27405 ns; half interval rounded up from 13702.5 ns.
Actual X/Z gates receive independent per-qubit depolarization before action, after active T1/T2; idle slots and ideal measurements receive storage noise only.
No separate readout error, source imperfection or quantum channel loss/noise; this is a literature-parameterized abstract processor, not a device reproduction.
100 Mb/s makes a swap result serialize in 8.8 us, below the shortest interval; network choices are controlled scenario assumptions.
All resources are created at t=0 and ready before the first request. Later sessions include additional storage age.
Zero load executes once per interval because traffic phase is inactive.
Calibration requests use 20 BSM durations (548100 ns) spacing, with all result packets emitted before background traffic ends.
Fidelity means are exact over the 16 chained or 4 swap measurement branches at each timing, not a sample mean over quantum seeds.
Feasibility thresholds are retained for audit only and are not the primary endpoint.
